name: products
description: Fetch a paginated list of fake products from DummyJSON. Supports limit, skip, and field selection via `select`. Returns product name, price, brand, category, thumbnail, and rating.

name: product
description: Fetch a single fake product by numeric `id` from DummyJSON. Returns name, description, price, discount, brand, category, stock, images, and rating.

name: product_search
description: Search fake DummyJSON products by keyword `q`. Returns matching products with name, price, brand, category, and rating. Supports limit and skip for pagination.

name: products_categories
description: Return the full list of product category names available in DummyJSON (e.g. smartphones, laptops, fragrances). Use before filtering products by category.

name: users
description: Fetch a paginated list of fake users from DummyJSON. Supports limit, skip, and field selection via `select`. Returns name, email, age, address, company, and role fields.

name: user
description: Fetch a single fake user by numeric `id` from DummyJSON. Returns full profile including name, email, phone, address, bank, company, and crypto wallet.

name: posts
description: Fetch a paginated list of fake blog posts from DummyJSON. Supports limit, skip, and field selection via `select`. Returns title, body, tags, reactions, and userId.

name: post
description: Fetch a single fake blog post by numeric `id` from DummyJSON. Returns title, body, tags, reaction counts, and the authoring userId.

name: comments
description: Fetch a paginated list of fake comments from DummyJSON. Supports limit and skip. Returns comment body, postId, and user info (id, username).

name: recipes
description: Fetch a paginated list of fake recipes from DummyJSON. Supports limit, skip, and field selection via `select`. Returns name, ingredients, instructions, prep time, and cuisine.

name: recipe
description: Fetch a single fake recipe by numeric `id` from DummyJSON. Returns name, ingredients, instructions, prep/cook time, servings, difficulty, and cuisine.

name: quotes
description: Fetch a paginated list of fake inspirational quotes from DummyJSON. Supports limit and skip. Returns quote text and author name.

name: todos
description: Fetch a paginated list of fake todo items from DummyJSON. Supports limit and skip. Returns todo text, completion status, and userId.
